# Bookshelf — Post-Implementation Delta

The Awtsmoos remembers every intention before a saved card can claim a name;
Awtsmoos.com compares plan with evidence until memory and implementation burn in the same clear flame.

## Planned

- Preserve `renderBookshelf(bookmarks, { onOpen, onRemove })`.
- Remove the runtime stylesheet factory.
- Replace `innerHTML` and `.onclick` with safe DOM and listeners.
- Split grouping/view/card responsibilities.
- Add three static scoped CSS modules with mobile and full interaction ownership.
- Keep every touched source <=120 lines.
- Add focused regression contracts, rerun the full Rebbe suite, and collect fresh route proof.

## Actual

- `ui/bookshelf.js` is now a 22-line stable gateway.
- `TiferesBookshelfView.js` owns grouping, root replacement, and the deliberate empty state.
- `MalchusBookshelfCardFactory.js` owns safe folder/track cards and explicit Open/Remove actions.
- Bookmark text enters through `textContent`; no active Bookshelf `innerHTML`, `.onclick`, or runtime `<style>` factory remains.
- `bookshelf-shell.css`, `bookshelf-cards.css`, and `bookshelf-interaction.css` are statically imported and scoped under `#bookshelf-list`.
- Cards use bounded `auto-fit` geometry, `min-inline-size:0`, and `overflow-wrap:anywhere`.
- Actions enforce 44px minimum height plus hover, active, focus-visible, disabled, narrow-phone, and reduced-motion states.
- Every touched Bookshelf source is <=81 lines and JS syntax is clean.
- Two Bookshelf regression contracts were added.
- Complete Rebbe suite passes 11/11.
- Fresh port 8914 returned HTTP 200 for `/apps/rebbe/` and the route loads the real core/main/ui/studio cascade.

## DELTA

Bookshelf itself has no unresolved implementation delta. Success exposed the next live node: Studio.

## NEXT_ACTION

Enter the live modular Studio graph through `modules/studio/index.js`; split the 266-line loaded stylesheet, remove raw property-control HTML/inline handlers, normalize named layers, and modularize live owners that exceed 120 lines.
